utterance: add a reminder to water the ferns tomorrow at 9am

precondition.applescript: tell application "Reminders" to count (every reminder whose name contains "water the ferns")

check.applescript:
tell application "Reminders"
set rs to (every reminder whose name contains "water the ferns" and completed is false)
if (count of rs) is 0 then return "none"
set d to due date of item 1 of rs
end tell
if d is missing value then return "no due date"
set t to (current date) + 1 * days
if (year of d = year of t) and (month of d = month of t) and (day of d = day of t) and (hours of d = 9) then return "ok"
return "bad " & (d as string)

teardown.applescript: tell application "Reminders" to delete (every reminder whose name contains "water the ferns")

utterance: add pick up oat milk to my Muselet Groceries list in Reminders, due Friday

setup.applescript: tell application "Reminders" to make new list with properties {name:"Muselet Groceries"}

check.applescript:
tell application "Reminders"
set rs to (every reminder of list "Muselet Groceries" whose name contains "oat milk")
if (count of rs) is 0 then return "none"
set d to due date of item 1 of rs
end tell
if d is missing value then return "no due date"
if weekday of d is Friday and d > (current date) and d < ((current date) + 8 * days) then return "ok"
return "bad " & (d as string)

utterance: add the meeting from this email to my calendar

precondition.applescript:
tell application "Calendar"
set n to 0
repeat with c in calendars
set n to n + (count (every event of c whose summary contains "Design review"))
end repeat
return n
end tell

setup.shell:
mkdir -p "{{sandbox}}/open-ended" && printf "From: Dana Park <dana@example.com>
To: me
Subject: Design review

Hi! Can we do the design review on Friday {{next_friday_ymd}} at 3:00 PM? It should take an hour, in the Lighthouse room.

Thanks,
Dana
" > "{{sandbox}}/open-ended/design-review-invite.txt" && open -a TextEdit "{{sandbox}}/open-ended/design-review-invite.txt" && sleep 2

check.applescript:
tell application "Calendar"
set found to ""
repeat with c in calendars
repeat with e in (every event of c whose summary contains "Design review")
set d to start date of e
set found to found & ((year of d) as string) & "-" & ((month of d as integer) as string) & "-" & ((day of d) as string) & " " & ((hours of d) as string) & ";"
end repeat
end repeat
return found
end tell

teardown.applescript:
tell application "Calendar"
repeat with c in calendars
delete (every event of c whose summary contains "Design review")
end repeat
end tell

note: The 'email' is a case-created plain-text file shown in TextEdit (Mail is guarded and never touched). next_friday_ymd is unpadded y-m-d like the setup text.
